UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Writer profile and pen name (takhallus) for a signed-in poet.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

penName.description: Display pen name chosen by the poet.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CommunityShayari.title: CommunityShayari
CommunityShayari.description: Original Shayari couplet composed and published by a community user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the author.

penName.description: Poet pen name displayed on the couplet card.

couplet.description: The composed Shayari text (10 to 500 characters).

promptTitle.description: Optional daily writing challenge prompt title, or empty string.

wahCount.description: Total number of Wah (applause) reactions from community users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when published (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PoetProfile.title: PoetProfile
PoetProfile.description: Public non-PII profile for a community poet including pen name, bio, follower/following counts, and published post count.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the poet.

penName.description: Public poet pen name (2 to 40 characters).

isPublic.description: Marks the profile discoverable to signed-in community users.

followerCount.description: Number of users following this poet.

followingCount.description: Number of poets this user is following.

postCount.description: Number of published community Shayari posts.

facebookUrl.description: Optional Facebook profile URL or handle (up to 160 characters).

instagramUrl.description: Optional Instagram profile URL or handle (up to 160 characters).

whatsappUrl.description: Optional WhatsApp link or number (up to 160 characters).

twitterUrl.description: Optional X (Twitter) profile URL or handle (up to 160 characters).

telegramUrl.description: Optional Telegram profile/channel URL or handle (up to 160 characters).

youtubeUrl.description: Optional YouTube channel URL or handle (up to 160 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserFollowing.title: UserFollowing
UserFollowing.description: Per-user marker recording that the owner follows a target poet.

targetUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the followed poet.

targetPenName.description: Pen name snapshot of the followed poet.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when followed (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PoetFollower.title: PoetFollower
PoetFollower.description: Public follower entry stored under a poet profile.

followerUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the follower.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when followed (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserWah.title: UserWah
UserWah.description: Record of a user's Wah (applause) reaction on a community Shayari.

shayariId.description: Document ID of the applauded community Shayari.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Wah reaction was added (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PersonalShayari.title: PersonalShayari
PersonalShayari.description: Private user-authored Shayari with a title or theme tag stored in the owner's personal collection.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the author.

title.description: Optional title for the user's Shayari (up to 80 characters).

themeTag.description: Theme or mood tag chosen or entered by the author (up to 40 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when saved (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ShayariComment.title: ShayariComment
ShayariComment.description: User comment on a Shayari card shared across authenticated users.

shayariKey.description: Identifier of the Shayari being commented on (e.g. seed_1).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the comment author.

authorName.description: Display name of the commenter (2 to 40 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PostNotification.title: PostNotification
PostNotification.description: Activity notification sent to a post author when another user likes, comments on, or shares their community Shayari post.

recipientUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the post author receiving the notification.

actorUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user performing like, comment, or share.

actorName.description: Display name or pen name of the user performing the action.

type.description: Type of post engagement or follow activity.

postId.description: Document ID of the target post in community_shayari, or 'profile' for follow notifications.

postExcerpt.description: Short couplet preview shown inside the notification row.

commentText.description: Comment text preview when type is comment, otherwise empty string.

isRead.description: Whether the recipient has read this notification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CommunityReel.title: CommunityReel
CommunityReel.description: Online Reel published by a signed-in user (free-form TikTok-style caption, optional user hashtags, photo/video thumbnail or preset backdrop).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Reel creator.

authorName.description: Display name of the Reel creator.

caption.description: Free-form TikTok-style caption or Shayari text written by the user (0..400 chars).

tags.description: Optional user-typed hashtags (0..10 items, never forced).

backgroundPreset.description: Optional built-in backdrop key for text-only Reels.

thumbnailBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG Base64 image or video poster frame for cross-device online display.

voicePersonaId.description: Optional preferred Shayar voice persona ID for text/photo Reels.

bgmTrackId.description: Optional preferred BGM track ID for text/photo Reels.

singerName.description: Optional detected or user-entered singer/vocalist name for video Reels (0..60 chars).

songTitle.description: Optional detected or user-entered song title for video Reels (0..80 chars).

likeCount.description: Atomic server-validated like count for the Reel.

status.description: Publication status required for scoped listing.

UserReelLike.title: UserReelLike
UserReelLike.description: Per-user Reel like marker atomically paired with community_reels.likeCount.

reelId.description: Document ID of the liked Reel in community_reels.

/users/{userId}.description: Private writer profile scoped to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/wahs/{shayariId}.description: Per-user applause markers atomically linked to community_shayari.wahCount.

/users/{userId}/reel_likes/{reelId}.description: Per-user Reel like markers atomically linked to community_reels.likeCount.

/users/{userId}/following/{targetUserId}.description: Per-user following list atomically linked to poet_profiles.followerCount.

/users/{userId}/personal_shayari/{shayar.description: Private personal Shayari collection owned by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: Inbox notifications for likes, comments, shares, and follows.

/poet_profiles/{poetUserId}.description: Public non-PII poet profiles discoverable by signed-in users.

/poet_profiles/{poetUserId}/followers/{f.description: Followers list under a public poet profile.

/community_shayari/{shayariId}.description: Shared community Shayari posts authored by signed-in poets.

/community_reels/{reelId}.description: Online Reels published by signed-in users with free-form captions and optional hashtags.

/shayari_comments/{commentId}.description: Comments posted by signed-in users on Shayari cards.
